DROP PROCEDURE [OM].[SP_UPDATE_PROCESS_DATE_MBK]
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROC [OM].[SP_UPDATE_PROCESS_DATE_MBK] AS


	BEGIN

		DECLARE @FLAG_SUCC_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
		DECLARE @FLAG_TASK_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
		DECLARE @NEXT_PROCESS_DATE [datetime]
		DECLARE @FLAG_INIT_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
		
		SELECT 
			@FLAG_INIT_CNT=COUNT(*)				
		FROM 
			(SELECT TOP 1 TASK_NAME FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN WHERE TASK_NAME like '%MBK%') OTR
		
				

		SELECT 
			@FLAG_SUCC_CNT=COUNT(DISTINCT OTR.TASK_NAME),
			@NEXT_PROCESS_DATE=MAX(dateadd(dd,1,EC.MBK_DATE))
		FROM 
			EDS.EDS_CTL EC
		INNER JOIN
			OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
			ON
			dateadd(dd,1,EC.MBK_DATE)=OTR.PROCESS_DATE
		INNER JOIN
			OM.OM_TASKS OT
			ON
			OT.TASK_NAME=OTR.TASK_NAME
			AND OT.SOURCE_CODE='MBK'
		INNER JOIN
			OM.OM_STATUS OS
			ON
			OS.STATUS_ID=OTR.STATUS_ID
		WHERE
			OS.STATUS='SUCCESSFUL'
		
		SELECT 
			@FLAG_TASK_CNT=COUNT(DISTINCT TASK_NAME) 
		FROM 
			OM.OM_TASKS OT
		WHERE
			OT.SOURCE_CODE='MBK'
	

		IF(@FLAG_SUCC_CNT<>@FLAG_TASK_CNT AND @FLAG_INIT_CNT>0)
			BEGIN
				--RAISERROR('CURRENT BUSINESS DATE STATUS IS NOT YET SUCCESSFUL FOR ALL MBK JOBS. PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE', 16,1)
				THROW 50001, 'CURRENT BUSINESS DATE STATUS IS NOT YET SUCCESSFUL FOR ALL MBK JOBS. PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE', 1;
			END
			
		IF(@NEXT_PROCESS_DATE IS NULL)
			BEGIN
				--RAISERROR('NO NEXT BUSINESS DATE RETRIEVED FROM EDS.DATE_DIM, OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE', 16,1)
				THROW 50002, 'NO NEXT BUSINESS DATE RETRIEVED FROM EDS.DATE_DIM, OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE', 1; 
			END
			
		UPDATE [EDS].[EDS_CTL] SET MBK_DATE=@NEXT_PROCESS_DATE

	END
GO
